import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def get(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
def parse_pdb(txt, chain=None):
    at={}
    for l in txt.split("\n"):
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        ch=l[21]
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        try: rn=int(l[22:26])
        except: continue
        at.setdefault(rn,{"res":l[17:20].strip(),"atoms":{},"b":[]})
        at[rn]["atoms"][l[12:16].strip()]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        at[rn]["b"].append(float(l[60:66]))
    return at
AF=parse_pdb(get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q07716-F1-model_v6.pdb"))
PTD=parse_pdb(get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTD.pdb"),"A")
YDY=parse_pdb(get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1YDY.pdb"),"A")

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); P0,Q0=P-Pc,Q-Qc
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd(P0.T@Q0)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); Dm=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=V@Dm@W
    return R,Pc,Qc
def apply(X,R,Pc,Qc): return (X-Pc)@R+Qc

def superpose_eval(mob,ref,anchors,cut=5.0):
    """anchors: list of (mob_resnum, ref_resnum); returns #CA pairs within cut and RMSD of those"""
    P=np.array([mob[a]["atoms"]["CA"] for a,_ in anchors])
    Q=np.array([ref[b]["atoms"]["CA"] for _,b in anchors])
    R,Pc,Qc=kabsch(P,Q)
    mk=sorted(mob); rk=sorted(ref)
    Mca=apply(np.array([mob[k]["atoms"]["CA"] for k in mk]),R,Pc,Qc)
    Rca=np.array([ref[k]["atoms"]["CA"] for k in rk])
    d=np.linalg.norm(Mca[:,None,:]-Rca[None,:,:],axis=2)
    mn=d.min(1)
    n=int((mn<cut).sum())
    rms=float(np.sqrt((mn[mn<cut]**2).mean())) if n else np.nan
    anc_rms=float(np.sqrt(((apply(P,R,Pc,Qc)-Q)**2).sum(1).mean()))
    return n,rms,anc_rms,(R,Pc,Qc)

print("Anchor-based superposition of AlphaFold AIM6 onto GlpQ 1YDY (3 anchor CA pairs).")
print("Metric: CA atoms of AIM6 within 5 A of any GlpQ CA after the 3-point fit.\n")
tests={
 "H120->H36, E141->E63, H156->H78": [(120,36),(141,63),(156,78)],
 "H118->H36, E141->E63, H156->H78": [(118,36),(141,63),(156,78)],
 "H120->H36, D143->D65, H156->H78": [(120,36),(143,65),(156,78)],
 "shuffled control (H313->H36,E165->E63,H343->H78)": [(313,36),(165,63),(343,78)],
}
res={}
for k,a in tests.items():
    n,rms,ar,T=superpose_eval(AF,YDY,a)
    res[k]=(n,rms,ar)
    print(f"  {k:52s} anchorRMSD={ar:.2f} A   CA<5A: {n:3d}/390   meanRMSD={rms:.2f}")

print("\nSame against B. cereus PI-PLC 1PTD (mature numbering His32/His82):")
for k,a in {"H120->H32, H156->H82 (+E141->D33 ctrl)":[(120,32),(156,82),(141,33)],
            "H118->H32, H156->H82 (+E141->D33 ctrl)":[(118,32),(156,82),(141,33)]}.items():
    n,rms,ar,T=superpose_eval(AF,PTD,a)
    print(f"  {k:52s} anchorRMSD={ar:.2f} A   CA<5A: {n:3d}/390   meanRMSD={rms:.2f}")

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.8))

# panel 1: motif spacing schematic from real numbers
ax=axes[0]
tracks={"AIM6 (Q07716)":[(118,"H"),(120,"H"),(122,"D"),(141,"E"),(143,"D"),(156,"H")],
        "GlpQ (P09394)":[(36,"H"),(63,"E"),(65,"D"),(78,"H")],
        "PI-PLC (1PTD)":[(32,"H"),(82,"H")]}
off={"AIM6 (Q07716)":115,"GlpQ (P09394)":31,"PI-PLC (1PTD)":22}
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(tracks.items()):
    y=len(tracks)-i
    xs=[p-off[k] for p,_ in v]
    ax.plot([0,max(xs)+10],[y,y],color="0.8",lw=3,zorder=0)
    for (p,a),x in zip(v,xs):
        ax.scatter([x],[y],s=160,color={"H":"#1b6ca8","E":"#c0392b","D":"#e08214"}[a],zorder=3)
        ax.text(x,y+0.16,f"{a}{p}",ha="center",fontsize=8.5)
    ax.text(-4,y,k,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-48,145); ax.set_ylim(0.4,3.7); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("residues from start of catalytic domain")
ax.set_title("Spacing of conserved acidic/His residues")
for s in ("top","right","left"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# panel 2: distance comparison
ax=axes[1]
def md(st,a,b):
    F={"HIS":["NE2","ND1"],"GLU":["OE1","OE2"],"ASP":["OD1","OD2"]}
    A=[st[a]["atoms"][x] for x in F[st[a]["res"]] if x in st[a]["atoms"]]
    B=[st[b]["atoms"][x] for x in F[st[b]["res"]] if x in st[b]["atoms"]]
    return min(float(np.linalg.norm(x-y)) for x in A for y in B)
pairs=[("His-His\ncatalytic pair",md(AF,120,156),md(YDY,36,78),md(PTD,32,82)),
       ("acidic pair\n(ExD)",md(AF,141,143),md(YDY,63,65),np.nan),
       ("acidic-His2",md(AF,143,156),md(YDY,65,78),np.nan)]
x=np.arange(len(pairs)); w=0.26
ax.bar(x-w,[p[1] for p in pairs],w,label="AIM6 (AlphaFold)",color="#1b6ca8")
ax.bar(x  ,[p[2] for p in pairs],w,label="GlpQ 1YDY",color="#7fb3d5")
ax.bar(x+w,[p[3] for p in pairs],w,label="PI-PLC 1PTD",color="#c0392b")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([p[0] for p in pairs],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("min side-chain heteroatom distance (A)")
ax.set_title("Active-site geometry"); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# panel 3: conservation
ax=axes[2]
consv={"H118":100,"H120":100,"D122":100,"Y123":100,"E141":100,"D143":100,"H156":100,"Y160":3}
ax.bar(list(consv),list(consv.values()),color=["#1b6ca8"]*7+["0.7"])
ax.set_ylabel("% identical in 30 orthologs\n(20 fungi, 10 bacteria)")
ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.set_title("Conservation in the AIM6 family (IPR039559)")
ax.tick_params(axis='x',rotation=45)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
